verses.uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
verses.indopak: صٓ ۗ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِى الذِّكْرِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: ﻿sad waalqurani thee alththikri
verses.saheeh: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
verses.khattab: Ṣãd. By the Quran, full of reminders
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Sād: God knows best what He means by this [letter]. By the Qur'an bearing the Remembrance, that is, [bearing] the Pronouncement; or [what is meant is that the Qur'an is a Book] of renown (the response to this oath has been omitted, in other words: ‘It is not as the Meccan disbelievers say, that there are many gods’).
verses.romanUrdu: Saad, kasam hai naseehat bharey Quran ki

verses.uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ
verses.indopak: بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِىْ عِزَّةٍ وَّشِقَاقٍ
verses.transliteration: bali allatheena kafaroo fee 'izzatin washiqaqin
verses.saheeh: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
verses.khattab: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but those who disbelieve, from among the people of Mecca, dwell in conceit, in self-glory and [in] disdain of faith, and defiance, disagreement with, and enmity towards, the Prophet (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Balke yahi log, jinhon ne maanney se inkar kiya hai, sakht takabbur aur zid mein mubtila hain

verses.uthmani: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ
verses.indopak: كَمْ اَهْلَـكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَّلَاتَ حِيْنَ مَنَاصٍ
verses.transliteration: kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin
verses.saheeh: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
verses.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape
verses.jalalayn: ﻿How many — in other words, many — a generation, a community of past communities, We have destroyed before them, and they cried out, when the chastisement was sent down on them, when it was no longer the time for escape, that is to say, the time was not one for fleeing (the [suffixed] tā’ [of wa-lāta] is extra; the sentence is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of [the verb] nādaw, ‘they cried out’) in other words, they called for help but the situation was such that there could be no escape or deliverance; but still the Meccan disbelievers have not taken heed from their example.
verses.romanUrdu: Insey pehle hum aisi kitni hi qaumon ko halaak kar chuke hain (aur jab unki shamat aayi hai) to woh cheekh utthey hain, magar woh waqt bachne ka nahin hota

verses.uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ
verses.indopak: وَعَجِبُوْۤا اَنْ جَاۤءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wa'ajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun
verses.saheeh: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
verses.khattab: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they marvel that a warner has come to them from among themselves, a messenger from among their number, to warn them and to threaten them with [the punishment of] the Fire after resurrection — and this [warner] is the Prophet (s). And those who disbelieve (the overt noun [al-kāfirūnā] has replaced the [third person] pronominalisation) say, ‘This is a sorcerer, a liar.
verses.romanUrdu: In logon ko is baat par bada taajub hua ke ek darane wala khud inhi mein se aa gaya, munkireen kehne lagey ke “yeh saahir(sorcerer) hai, sakht jhoota hai

verses.uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ
verses.indopak: اَجَعَلَ الْاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًا ۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
verses.transliteration: aja'ala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon 'ujabun
verses.saheeh: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
verses.khattab: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Has he made the gods One God? — for he had said to them, ‘Say: there is no god except God’ — in other words [they objected]: how could one god suffice for all of creation? Lo! that is indeed a curious thing’.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya isney saarey khudaon ki jagah bas ek hi khuda bana dala? Yeh to badi ajeeb baat hai”

verses.uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ
verses.indopak: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْهُمْ اَنِ امْشُوْا وَاصْبِرُوْا عَلٰۤى اٰلِهَتِكُمْ ۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُّرَادُ ۖ
verses.transliteration: waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo 'ala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu
verses.saheeh: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
verses.khattab: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the council from among them go about, from the place of their assembly at the house of Abū Tālib and [the place] where they heard the Prophet (s) say, ‘Say: there is no god except God’, saying, ‘Go!, they say to one another, go, and stand by your gods, adhere firmly to worship of them; lo! this, that has been mentioned concerning the Oneness of God, is indeed a thing sought, from us.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur sardaran e qaum yeh kehte huey nikal gaye ke “ chalo aur dat-tey raho apne maboodon ki ibadat par. Yeh baat to kisi aur hi garaz se kahi ja rahi hai

verses.uthmani: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
verses.indopak: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِى الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةِ ۖ اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ma sami'na bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun
verses.saheeh: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
verses.khattab: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We never heard of this in the latter-day creed, namely, the creed of Jesus. This is surely [nothing] but an invention, [mere] lies.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh baat humne zamana e qareeb ki millat mein kisi se nahin suni. Yeh kuch nahin hai magar ek man-ghadat baat

verses.uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا ۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِي ۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
verses.indopak: ءَاُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِنَا ۗ بَلْ هُمْ فِىْ شَكٍّ مِّنْ ذِكْرِىْ ۚ بَلْ لَّمَّا يَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: aonzila 'alayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo 'athabi
verses.saheeh: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
verses.khattab: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Has the Remembrance, the Qur'an, been revealed to him, Muhammad (s), out of [all of] us’, when he is neither the elder nor the noblest among us? In other words, it could not have been revealed to him (read a-unzila pronouncing both hamzas, or not pronouncing the second one, but in both cases inserting an intervening alif or without [this insertion]). God, exalted be He, says: Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My Remembrance, My revelation, that is, the Qur'an, for they deny the one who has brought it. Nay, but they have not yet tasted My chastisement, and if they were to taste it, they would certainly believe the Prophet (s) in what he has brought — but then [in such a case] their belief [in the Prophet] would be of no benefit to them.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya hamarey darmiyan bas yahi ek shaks reh gaya tha jispar Allah ka zikr nazil kardiya gaya?”Asal baat yeh hai ke yeh mere “Zikr” par shakk kar rahey hain , aur yeh saari baatein isliye kar rahey hain ke inhon ne mere azaab ka maza chakkha nahin hai

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
verses.indopak: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَاۤٮِٕنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيْزِ الْوَهَّابِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: am 'indahum khazainu rahmati rabbika al'azeezi alwahhabi
verses.saheeh: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
verses.khattab: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord’s mercy, the Mighty, the Victor, the Bestower?, [treasuries] such as prophethood and otherwise, so that they might give it to whomever they want?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tere daata (great Bestower) aur gaalib parwardigar ki rehmat ke khazane inke kabze mein hain

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
verses.indopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ مُّلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۗ فَلْيَرْتَقُوْا فِى الْاَسْبَابِ
verses.transliteration: am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi
verses.saheeh: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
verses.khattab: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they possess the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? If this is what they claim: Then let them ascend by the means, [of ascension] that lead to the heaven and bring [down] some revelation (wahy) and then assign it exclusively to whomever they wish (am in both verses represents the [rhetorical] hamza of denial).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh aasmaan o zameen aur inke darmiyan ki cheezon ke maalik hain? Accha to yeh aalam e asbaab ki bulandiyon par chadh kar dekhein

verses.uthmani: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
verses.indopak: جُنْدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُوْمٌ مِّنَ الْاَحْزَابِ
verses.transliteration: jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi
verses.saheeh: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
verses.khattab: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there
verses.jalalayn: ﻿A routed (mahzūmun is an adjectival qualification of jundun, ‘host’) host [is all that they are], in other words, they are [nothing but] a despicable host, nothing more — in their denial of you — from among the factions (mina’l-ahzābi, also an adjectival qualification of jundun) in other words, [they are] like those hosts of factions who were in confederation against prophets before you: these were defeated and destroyed, and likewise We shall destroy these [people].
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh to jatthon (armies) mein se ek choota sa jattha (army) hai jo isi jagah shikhast(suffer defeat) khane wala hai

verses.uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
verses.indopak: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْاَوْتَادِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa'adun wafir'awnu thoo alawtadi
verses.saheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
verses.khattab: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’Âd, Pharaoh of the mighty structures
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Before them the people of Noah denied (the inflection of [the verb kadhdabat, ‘denied’, that is governed by] qawmu, ‘people’, is in the feminine person because of the [implicit] sense), and [so did those of] ‘Ād and Pharaoh, he of the stakes — he used to fix four stakes for the person who incurred his wrath and tie to these [stakes] that person’s hands and feet and then torture him —
verses.romanUrdu: Insey pehle Nooh ki qaum, aur Aad, aur mekhon (tent-pegs/stakes) wala Firoun

verses.uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِ ۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
verses.indopak: وَثَمُوْدُ وَقَوْمُ لُوْطٍ وَّاَصْحٰبُ لْئَیْكَةِ ۗ اُولٰۤٮِٕكَ الْاَحْزَابُ
verses.transliteration: wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu
verses.saheeh: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
verses.khattab: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Thamūd and the people of Lot and the dwellers in the wood, a small forest, namely, the people of Shu‘ayb, peace be upon him — those were the factions.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Samood, aur qaum e Lut, aur aika waley jhutla chuke hain. Jatthay woh thay

verses.uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.indopak: اِنْ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.transliteration: in kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa 'iqabi
verses.saheeh: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
verses.khattab: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Each one, of the factions, did not but deny the messengers, for when they deny one, they have [in effect] denied them all, since their call [to God] is [the same] one, namely, the call to [affirmation of] His Oneness. So My retribution was justified, [it was] necessary.
verses.romanUrdu: Unmein se har ek ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya aur meri uqubat ka faisla (decree of chastisement )uspar chaspan ho kar raha

verses.uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ
verses.transliteration: wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin
verses.saheeh: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
verses.khattab: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And these, that is, the disbelievers of Mecca, do not await but a single Cry, namely, the Blast of the Resurrection that will herald chastisement for them, for which there will be no revoking (read fawāq or fuwāq).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log bhi bas ek dhamake ke muntazir hain jiske baad koi dusra dhamaka na hoga

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo rabbana 'ajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi
verses.saheeh: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
verses.khattab: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they said — after the following [verse] was revealed, As for him who is given his book in his right hand … to the end [of the verse, Q. 69:19] — ‘Our Lord, hasten on for us the record of our deeds before the Day of Reckoning’ — they said this mockingly.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh kehte hain ke aey hamare Rubb, yaum ul hisaab(hisab ke din) se pehle hi hamara hissa humein jaldi se dey dey

verses.uthmani: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.indopak: اِصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الْاَيْدِ ۚ اِنَّـهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: isbir 'ala ma yaqooloona waothkur 'abdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun
verses.saheeh: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
verses.khattab: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Bear patiently what they say and remember Our servant David, the one of fortitude, that is to say, [the one] of fortitude in worship: he used to fast every other day and keep vigil for half the night, sleep for a third and then keep vigil for the [last] sixth. Indeed he was a penitent [soul], always returning to what pleases God.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi), sabr karo un baaton par jo yeh log banate hain, aur inke saamne hamare banday Dawood ka qissa bayan karo jo badi quwaton ka maalik tha. Har maamle mein Allah ki taraf rujoo karne wala tha

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِىِّ وَالْاِشْرَاقِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna sakhkharna aljibala ma'ahu yusabbihna bial'ashiyyi waalishraqi
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
verses.khattab: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly We disposed the mountains to glorify [God] with him, with the same glorification, at evening, at the time of the night prayer, and at sunrise, at the time of the morning prayer, which is when the sun has fully risen with its light extending everywhere.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne pahadon ko uske saath musakkhar kar rakkha tha ke subah o shaam woh uske saath tasbeeh karte thay

verses.uthmani: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗ ۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
verses.indopak: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُوْرَةً ۗ كُلٌّ لَّـهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun
verses.saheeh: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
verses.khattab: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And, We disposed, the birds, mustered [in flocks], gathered before him, glorifying with him; each, of the mountains and birds, turning to him, reverting to obedience of him by glorifying [God with him].
verses.romanUrdu: Parindey simat aate aur sabke sab uski tasbeeh ki taraf mutawajjeh ho jatey thay

verses.uthmani: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
verses.indopak: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهٗ وَاٰتَيْنٰهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi
verses.saheeh: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
verses.khattab: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We strengthened his Kingdom, We reinforced it with guards and hosts: every night there thirty thousand men would be standing guard at his sanctuary; and gave him wisdom, prophethood and sound judgement in [all] matters, and decisive speech, [the ability to formulate] a satisfactory statement [for a decision] in any endeavour.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne uski sultanat mazboot kardi thi, usko hikmat ata ki thi aur faislay-kun baat kehne ki salahiyat bakshi thi

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَهَلْ اَتٰٮكَ نَبَؤُا الْخَصْمِ ۘ اِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba
verses.saheeh: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
verses.khattab: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And has there come to you, O Muhammad (s) (the purpose of the interrogative [indicated by hal] here is to provoke curiosity and a desire to listen to what will follow) the tale of the disputants, when they scaled the sanctuary?, David’s sanctuary, that is, his place of prayer, for they had been prohibited from entering by the [front] gates because of his being engaged in worship, in other words, [has it come to you] their tale and their account?
verses.romanUrdu: Phir tumhein kuch khabar pahunchi hai un muqaddame walon ki jo deewaar chadh kar uske baala khaane(private chambers) mein ghus aaye thay

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡ ۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ ۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.indopak: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلٰى دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ ۚ خَصْمٰنِ بَغٰى بَعْضُنَا عَلٰى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَاۤ اِلٰى سَوَاۤءِ الصِّرَاطِ
verses.transliteration: ith dakhaloo 'ala dawooda fafazi'a minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha ba'duna 'ala ba'din faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati
verses.saheeh: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
verses.khattab: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When they entered upon David, and he was frightened by them. And they said, ‘Do not fear; we are, two disputants (some say that this means ‘two groups’, in order to agree with the plural person [of the verb dakhalū, ‘they entered’]; others say, ‘two individuals’ with the plural person actually denoting these two; al-khasm may refer to a one or more individuals. These two were angels who had come in the form of two disputants, between whom there [was supposed to have] occurred the situation mentioned — [but] only hypothetically — in order to alert David, peace be upon him, to what he had done: he had ninety nine women but desired the woman of a man who had only her and no other. He [David] had married her and consummated the marriage. One of us has infringed upon the [rights of the] other, so judge justly between us and do not transgress, [do not] be unjust, and guide us, direct us, to the right path’, the correct way.
verses.romanUrdu: Jab woh Dawood ke paas pahunche to woh unhein dekh kar ghabra gaya, unhon ne kaha “dariye nahin, hum do fareeq muqaddama hain jin mein se ek ne dusre par zyadati ki hai. Aap hamare darmiyan theek theek haqq ke saath faisla kardijiye, be-insafi na kijiye aur humein raah e raast bataiye

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعٞ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةٗ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ هٰذَاۤ اَخِىْ ۗ لَهٗ تِسْعٌ وَّتِسْعُوْنَ نَعْجَةً وَّلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ ۗ فَقَالَ اَكْفِلْنِيْهَا وَعَزَّنِىْ فِى الْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: inna hatha akhee lahu tis'un watis'oona na'jatan waliya na'jatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha wa'azzanee fee alkhitabi
verses.saheeh: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
verses.khattab: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Behold, this brother of mine, in other words, my fellow co-religionist, has ninety-nine ewes — here used to represent the women — while I have a single ewe; yet he said, “Entrust it to me”, in other words, make me in charge of it, and he overcame me in speech’, in other words, in the argument; so the latter conceded charge of it to him.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh meri bhai hai ,iske paas ninanve (ninety nine) dumbiyan(ewes) hai aur mere paas sirf ek hi dumbi (ewe) hai , isne mujhse kaha ke yeh ek dumbi bhi mere hawale karde aur isne guftagu mein mujhe daba liya”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٞ مَّا هُمۡ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعٗا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.indopak: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ اِلٰى نِعَاجِهٖ ۗ وَاِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَـطَاۤءِ لَيَبْغِىْ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَلِيْلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّاَنَابَ ۩
verses.transliteration: qala laqad thalamaka bisuali na'jatika ila ni'ajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee ba'duhum 'ala ba'din illa allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra raki'an waanaba
verses.saheeh: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
verses.khattab: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘He has certainly wronged you by asking for your ewe that he may add it to his sheep. And indeed many associates infringe upon [the rights of] one another, except such as believe and perform righteous deeds, but few are they!’ (mā emphasises the ‘fewness’). As the two angels were ascending to the heaven one said to the other, ‘He has certainly passed judgement on himself!’ David was thus alerted [to his deed]. God, exalted be He, says: And David thought, in other words, he became certain, that We had indeed tried him, that We had caused him to fall into a trial, that is, a test, through his love for that woman. So he sought forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing, in other words, prostrate, and repented.
verses.romanUrdu: Dawood ne jawab diya: “is shaks ne apni dumbiyon (ewes) ke saath teri dumbi mila lene ka mutalaba karke yaqeenan tujhpar zulm kiya, aur waqiya yeh hai ke mil-jhul kar saath rehne waley log aksar ek dusre par zyadatiyan karte rehte hain, bas wahi log is se bachey huey hain jo iman rakhte hain aur amal e saleh karte hain, aur aisey log kam hi hain.” (Yeh baat kehte kehte) Dawood samajh gaya ke yeh to humne dar-asal iski aazmaish ki hai, chunanche usne apne Rubb se maafi maangi aur sajde mein gir gaya aur rujoo karliya

verses.uthmani: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
verses.indopak: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَ ۗ وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰى وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ
verses.transliteration: faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu 'indana lazulfa wahusna maabin
verses.saheeh: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.khattab: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We forgave him that and indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us, that is, [even] more good [things] in this world, and a fair return, in the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Tab humne iska woh kasoor maaf kiya aur yaqeenan hamare haan uske liye taqarrub ka muqaam aur behtar anjaam hai

verses.uthmani: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
verses.indopak: يٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰكَ خَلِيْفَةً فِى الْاَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوٰى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَضِلُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌ بِۢمَا نَسُوْا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: ya dawoodu inna ja'alnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabi'i alhawa fayudillaka 'an sabeeli allahi inna allatheena yadilloona 'an sabeeli allahi lahum 'athabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi
verses.saheeh: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
verses.khattab: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘O David! We have indeed made you a vicegerent on the earth, managing the affairs of people; so judge justly between people and do not follow desire, that is, the desires of the soul, that it then lead you astray from the way of God, that is to say, from the proofs that indicate [the truth of] His Oneness. Truly those who go astray from the way of God, in other words, from belief in God — for them there will be a severe chastisement because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning’, as a result of their having neglected faith. For had they been certain of [the truth of] the Day of Reckoning, they would have [first] been believers in this world.
verses.romanUrdu: (Humne ussey kaha) “Aey dawood, humne tujhey zameen mein khalifa banaya hai, lihaza tu logon ke darmiyan haqq ke saath hukumat kar, aur khwaish e nafs ki pairwi na kar ke woh tujhey Allah ki raah se bhatka degi. Jo log Allah ki raah se bhatakte hain yaqeenan unke liye sakht saza hai ke woh yaum ul hisaab ko bhool gaye.”

wbw.translation: for it will lead you astray

verses.uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.indopak: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاۤءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ۗ ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنَ النَّارِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari
verses.saheeh: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
verses.khattab: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in vain, frivolously. That, namely, the creation of what has been mentioned as being for no [particular] purpose, is the supposition of those who disbelieve, from among the people of Mecca. So woe — a valley [in hell-fire] — to the disbelievers from the Fire!
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is aasmaan aur zameen ko, aur is duniya ko jo inke darmiyan hai , fizool paida nahin kardiya hai, yeh to un logon ka gumaan hai jinhon ne kufr kiya hai aur aisey kaafiron ke liye barbadi hai jahannum ki aag se

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
verses.indopak: اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ۖ اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ كَالْفُجَّارِ
verses.transliteration: am naj'alu allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am naj'alu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari
verses.saheeh: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
verses.khattab: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or shall We treat those who believe and perform righteous deeds like those who cause corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the God-fearing like the profligate? This was revealed when the Meccan disbelievers said to the believers, ‘In the Hereafter we will receive the same [reward] as that which you will receive’ (am, ‘or’, contains the [rhetorical] hamza of denial).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya hum un logon ko jo iman laatey hain aur neik aamaal karte hain aur unko jo zameen mein fasad karne waley hain yaksan kardein? Kya muttaqiyon ko hum faajiron(wicked) jaisa kardein

verses.uthmani: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكٞ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
verses.indopak: كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اِلَيْكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوْۤا اٰيٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوا الْاَ لْبَابِ
verses.transliteration: kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi
verses.saheeh: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
verses.khattab: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿A Book (kitābun, the predicate of a missing subject, namely, hādhā, ‘this is’) that We have revealed to you, full of blessing, that they may contemplate (yaddabbarū is actually yatadabbarū, but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl) its signs, [that] they may reflect upon its meanings and become believers, and that they may remember, that they may be admonished — those people of pith, those possessors of intellect.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ek badi barakat wali kitaab hai jo (aey Muhammad) humne tumhari taraf nazil ki hai taa-ke yeh log iski aayat par gaur karein aur aqal o fikr rakhne wale issey sabaq lein

verses.uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ ۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.indopak: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَيْمٰنَ ۗ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۗ اِنَّـهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana ni'ma al'abdu innahu awwabun
verses.saheeh: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
verses.khattab: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We bestowed on David, Solomon, his son — what an excellent servant!, that is, Solomon. Truly he was a penitent [soul], always returning [to God] with glorification and remembrance at all times.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Dawood ko humne Sulaiman (jaisa beta) ata kiya, behtareen banda, kasrat se apne Rubb ki taraf rujoo karne wala

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
verses.indopak: اِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِىِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الْجِيَادُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: ith 'urida 'alayhi bial'ashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu
verses.saheeh: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
verses.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When one evening — which is the period after midday — there were displayed before him the prancing steeds (al-sāfināt, ‘horses’, is the plural of sāfina, which denotes [a horse] standing on three legs with the fourth supported on the edge of the hoof, and derives from [the verb] safana, yasfinu sufūnan; al-jiyād is the plural of jawād, which is a ‘racer’; the meaning is that these [horses] are such that when they are halted they stand still and when they run they surpass [others] in speed). One thousand horses were displayed before him after he had performed the midday prayer, for he had wanted to use them in a holy struggle (jihād) against an enemy. But when the display reached the nine-hundredth [horse], the sun set and he had not performed the afternoon prayer. So he was greatly distressed.
verses.romanUrdu: Kaabil e zikr hai woh mauqa jab shaam ke waqt us ke saamne khoob sidhey (well-trained) huey tez-rau(running) ghoday (horses) pesh kiye gaye

verses.uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
verses.indopak: فَقَالَ اِنِّىْۤ اَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّىْ ۚ حَتّٰى تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri 'an thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi
verses.saheeh: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
verses.khattab: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Lo! I have loved, I have desired, the love of [worldly] good things, that is, [of] horses, over the remembrance of my Lord’, that is, [over] the afternoon prayer, until it, that is, the sun, disappeared behind the [night’s] veil, [until] it was concealed by that which veils it from sight.
verses.romanUrdu: To usne kaha “maine is maal ki muhabbat apne Rubb ki yaad ki wajah se ikhtiyar ki hai” yahan tak ke jab woh ghoday (horses) nigaah se ojhal ho gaye

verses.uthmani: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
verses.indopak: رُدُّوْهَا عَلَىَّ ۗ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِۢالسُّوْقِ وَ الْاَعْنَاقِ
verses.transliteration: ruddooha 'alayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waala'naqi
verses.saheeh: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
verses.khattab: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Bring them back to me!, that is, the horses that were displayed; and they so brought them back. Then he set about slashing, with his sword, [their] legs (al-sūq is the plural of sāq) and necks, in other words, he slaughtered them and cut off their legs as an offering [of atonement] to God, exalted be He, for having been distracted by them from the prayer. He gave all the meat thereof as voluntary alms and so God compensated him what was better and faster that these [horses], and this was the wind, which blew at his command as he wished.
verses.romanUrdu: To (usne hukum diya ke) inhein mere paas wapas laao, phir laga unki pindliyon (legs) aur gardano (necks) par haath pherne

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَلْقَيْنَا عَلٰى كُرْسِيِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ
verses.transliteration: walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna 'ala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba
verses.saheeh: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
verses.khattab: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We certainly tried Solomon: We tested him by wresting his kingdom from him, because he had married a woman [solely] out of his desire for her. She used to worship idols in his [own] home without his knowledge. Now, [control of] his kingdom lay in his ring. On one occasion, needing to withdraw [to relieve himself], he took it off and left it with this woman of his, whose name was al-Amīna, as was his custom; but a jinn, [disguised] in the form of Solomon, came to her and seized it from her. And We cast upon his throne a [lifeless] body, which was that [very] jinn, and he was [the one known as] Sakhr — or it was some other [jinn]; he sat upon Solomon’s throne and so [as was the case with Solomon] the birds and other [creatures] devoted themselves to him [in service]. When Solomon came out [of his palace], having seen him [the jinn] upon his throne, he said to the people, ‘I am Solomon [not him]!’ But they did not recognise him. Then he repented — Solomon returned to his kingdom, many days later, after he had managed to acquire the ring. He wore it and sat upon his throne [again].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (dekho ke) Sulaiman ko bhi humne aazmaish mein daala aur uski kursi par ek jasad (mere body/body without life) laa kar daal diya phir usne rujoo kiya

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِىْ وَهَبْ لِىْ مُلْكًا لَّا يَنْۢبَغِىْ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِىْ ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min ba'dee innaka anta alwahhabu
verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
verses.khattab: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘My Lord! Forgive me and grant me a kingdom that shall not belong to anyone after me, in other words, other than me (this [use of min ba‘dī to mean ‘other than me’] is similar to [Q. 45:23] fa-man yahdīh min ba‘di’Llāh, ‘who will guide him other than God?’). Truly You are the Bestower’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kaha ke “aey mere Rubb , mujhey maaf karde aur mujhey woh baadshahi de jo mere baad kisi ke liye sazawar na ho, beshak tu hi asal daata hai”

verses.uthmani: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
verses.indopak: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيْحَ تَجْرِىْ بِاَمْرِهٖ رُخَاۤءً حَيْثُ اَصَابَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba
verses.saheeh: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
verses.khattab: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We disposed for him the wind, which blew softly, gently, at his command wherever he intended.
verses.romanUrdu: Tab humne uske liye hawa ko musakkhar kardiya jo uske hukum se narmi ke saath chalti thi jidhar woh chahta tha

verses.uthmani: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٖ وَغَوَّاصٖ
verses.indopak: وَالشَّيٰطِيْنَ كُلَّ بَنَّاۤءٍ وَّغَوَّاصٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin
verses.saheeh: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
verses.khattab: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And the devils [also We disposed], every builder, building marvellous edifices, and diver, in the sea, bringing up pearls,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur shayateen ko musakkhar kardiya, har tarah ke meimaar(builders) aur gotakhor (divers)

verses.uthmani: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
verses.indopak: وَّاٰخَرِيْنَ مُقَرَّنِيْنَ فِى الْاَصْفَادِ
verses.transliteration: waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi
verses.saheeh: And others bound together in shackles.
verses.khattab: and others bound together in chains
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and others too, from among them, bounded together in fetters, in shackles with their hands tied to their necks.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dusre jo paband e salasil thay(bound with chains)

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا عَطَاۤؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ اَوْ اَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.transliteration: hatha 'ataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin
verses.saheeh: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
verses.khattab: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We said to him: ‘This is Our gift. So bestow, grant thereof to whomever you wish, or withhold, from giving, without any reckoning’, in other words, without your being called to account for any of this.
verses.romanUrdu: (humne ussey kaha) “ yeh hamari bakshish hai, tujhey ikhtiyar hai jisey chahe de aur jissey chahe rok le, koi hisaab nahin”

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰى وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ
verses.transliteration: wainna lahu 'indana lazulfa wahusna maabin
verses.saheeh: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.khattab: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a fair resort — a similar [statement] has already appeared [in another verse above].
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan uske liye hamare haan taqarrub ka muqaam aur behtar anjaam hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبٖ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.indopak: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَاۤ اَيُّوْبَ ۘ اِذْ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗۤ اَنِّىْ مَسَّنِىَ الشَّيْطٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَّعَذَابٍ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waothkur 'abdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin wa'athabin
verses.saheeh: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
verses.khattab: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And mention also Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, [saying], ‘Lo! Satan has afflicted me with hardship, harm, and suffering’, pain: he attributes all this to Satan, even though all things are from God, to show reverence [in his call] to Him, exalted be He.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hamare banday Ayub ka zikar karo, jab usne apne Rubb ko pukara ke shaytaan ne mujhey sakht takleef aur azaab mein daal diya hai

verses.uthmani: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ
verses.indopak: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۚ هٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَّشَرَابٌ
verses.transliteration: orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun
verses.saheeh: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
verses.khattab: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it was said to him: ‘Stamp your foot, on the ground — and he stamped [it] and a spring of water gushed forth, and it was said: This is a cool bath, [cool] water for you to wash with, and a drink’, for you to drink of. So he washed himself and drank [from it] whereat every ailment that had affected him internally and externally disappeared.
verses.romanUrdu: (Humne usey hukum diya) apna paaon (leg) zameen par maar, yeh hai thanda pani nahane ke liya aur peene ke liye

wbw.translation: (is a spring of) water to bathe

verses.uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
verses.indopak: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗۤ اَهْلَهٗ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرٰى لِاُولِى الْاَ لْبَابِ
verses.transliteration: wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum ma'ahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi
verses.saheeh: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.khattab: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We gave him [back] his family along with others like them, that is, God brought back to life all the children of his that had died and provided him with as many [in addition to them], as a mercy, a grace, from us, and a reminder, an admonition, to people of pith, possessors of intellect.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne usey uske ahal o ayaal wapas diye aur unke saath utnay hi aur, apni taraf se rehmat ke taur par, aur aqal o fikar rakhne walon ke liye dars ke taur par

verses.uthmani: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗا ۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
verses.indopak: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِّهٖ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ اِنَّا وَجَدْنٰهُ صَابِرًا ۗ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۗ اِنَّـهٗۤ اَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran ni'ma al'abdu innahu awwabun
verses.saheeh: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
verses.khattab: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [We said to him], ‘Take in your hand a bunch of twigs, or some blades of grass, and smite therewith, your wife — for he had sworn to smite her a hundred times on one occasion when she was late in coming to him — and do not break [your] oath’, by not smiting her: so he took a hundred rushes and smote her with them once [and that sufficed to fulfil his oath]. Truly We found him to be steadfast. What an excellent servant!, [was] Job. Indeed he was a penitent [soul], always returning to God, exalted be He.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aur humne issey kaha) tinkon ka ek mutta lay (bundle of rushes) aur ussey maar de, apni kasam na todh, humne usey saabir paya, behtareen banda, apne Rubb ki taraf bahut rujoo karne wala

verses.uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
verses.indopak: وَاذْكُرْ عِبٰدَنَاۤ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَ اُولِى الْاَيْدِىْ وَالْاَبْصَارِ
verses.transliteration: waothkur 'ibadana ibraheema waishaqa waya'qooba olee alaydee waalabsari
verses.saheeh: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
verses.khattab: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And mention [also] Our servants Abraham, and Isaac and Jacob — men of fortitude, vigorous in their worship, and insight, deep understanding of religion (a variant reading [for ‘ibādanā, ‘Our servants’] has [singular] ‘abdanā, ‘Our servant’, with Ibrāhīma as the explication thereof, and what follows as being a supplement to ‘abdanā, ‘Our servant’).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hamare bandon , Ibrahim aur Ishaq aur Yaqub ka zikar karo badi quwwat e amail rakhne wale aur deedhawar (strength and vision)log thay

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٖ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَخْلَصْنٰهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
verses.khattab: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly We purified them with an exclusive [thought], namely, the remembrance of the Abode, of the Hereafter: in other words to [always] remember it and to work for it (a variant reading [for bi-khālisatin dhikrā’l-dār] has the genitive construction [bi-khālisati dhikrā’l-dār], making this [dhikrā al-dār, ‘remembrance of the Abode’] the explicative thereof).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne unko ek khaalis siffat ki bina par barguzida kiya tha, aur woh daar-e-aakhirat ki yaad thi

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْاَخْيَارِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wainnahum 'indana lamina almustafayna alakhyari
verses.saheeh: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
verses.khattab: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed in Our sight they are of the elect, the excellent (akhyār is the plural of khayyir).
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan hamare haan unka shumaar chunay huey neik ashkhaas(excellent ones) mein hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِ ۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
verses.indopak: وَاذْكُرْ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَ الْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۗ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْاَخْيَارِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waothkur isma'eela wailyasa'a watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari
verses.saheeh: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
verses.khattab: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And mention [also] Our servants Ishmael, and Elisha, who was a prophet (the lām [here in al-Yasa‘] is extra) and Dhū’l-Kifl — there is disagreement over whether he was a prophet; it is said that [he was so called because] he looked after (kafala) a hundred prophets who had sought refuge with him from being killed. Each, that is, every one of them, was among the excellent (akhyār is the plural of khayyir).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Ismail aur Al-yasa(Elisha) aur Zulkifl ka zikr karo, yeh sab neik logon mein se thay

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۗ وَاِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ لَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin
verses.saheeh: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
verses.khattab: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This is a remembrance, of them, [made] by [the mention of] fair praise [of them] here; and indeed for the God-fearing, who comprise them, there will truly be a fair return, in the Hereafter —
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ek zikar tha. (Ab suno ke) muttaqi logon ke liye yaqeenan behtareen thikana hai

verses.uthmani: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖ مُّفَتَّحَةٗ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
verses.indopak: جَنّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْاَبْوَابُ ۚ
verses.transliteration: jannati 'adnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu
verses.saheeh: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
verses.khattab: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Gardens of Eden (jannāti ‘Adnin is either a substitution for, or an explicative supplement to, husna ma’ābin, ‘a fair return’) whose gates are [flung] open for them;
verses.romanUrdu: Hamesha rehne wali jannatein jinke darwaze unke liye khuley hongey

verses.uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ وَشَرَابٖ
verses.indopak: مُتَّكِـــِٕيْنَ فِيْهَا يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيْرَةٍ وَّشَرَابٍ
verses.transliteration: muttakieena feeha yad'oona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin
verses.saheeh: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
verses.khattab: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿reclining therein, on couches; therein they call for plenteous fruit and drink.
verses.romanUrdu: Unmein woh takiye lagaye baithay hongey, khoob khoob fawake aur mashroobat (abundant fruit and drinks) talab kar rahey hongey

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَعِنْدَهُمْ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرْفِ اَتْرَابٌ
verses.transliteration: wa'indahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun
verses.saheeh: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
verses.khattab: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And with them [there] will be maidens of restrained glances, restricting their eyes to their spouses, of a like age, of the same age, girls who are thirty three years of age (atrāb is the plural of tirb).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unke paas sharmili humsin biwiyan hongi

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: hatha ma too'adoona liyawmi alhisabi
verses.saheeh: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
verses.khattab: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘This, that is mentioned, is what you are promised, by way of the unseen (there is a shift in the address away from the third [to the second] person]) for the Day of Reckoning.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh woh chezein hain jinhein hisaab ke din ata karne ka tumse wada kiya ja raha hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنْ نَّـفَادٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
verses.khattab: This is indeed Our provision that will never end
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This is indeed Our provision, which will never be exhausted’, in other words, one which will never cease (this [last] sentence [mā lahu min nafādin] is a circumstantial qualifier referring to rizqunā, ‘Our provision’; or it is a second predicate of inna, ‘indeed’, meaning that it will be ‘everlasting’).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh hamara rizq hai jo kabhi khatam honaywala nahin

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٖ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا ۗ وَاِنَّ لِلطّٰغِيْنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin
verses.saheeh: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
verses.khattab: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That, which is mentioned, will be [the reward] for the believers [is so]; but for the insolent (this is a new sentence) there will surely be an evil [place of] return —
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh to hai muttaqiyon ka anjaam aur sarkashon ke liye badhtareen (evil) thikana hai

verses.uthmani: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
verses.indopak: جَهَـنَّمَ ۚ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۚ فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
verses.transliteration: jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu
verses.saheeh: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
verses.khattab: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Hell, which they will enter — an evil resting place!
verses.romanUrdu: Jahannum jismein woh jhulse jayenge. Bahut hi buri qayamgaah

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٞ وَغَسَّاقٞ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا ۙ فَلْيَذُوْقُوْهُ حَمِيْمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun
verses.saheeh: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
verses.khattab: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This, chastisement — inferred [as so] by what follows — let them then taste it: burning hot water and pus (read ghasāq or ghassāq), the festering matter excreted by the inhabitants of the Fire;
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh hai unke liye, pas woh maza chakhein khautley (boiling) huey pani aur peep lahu (pus)

verses.uthmani: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ
verses.indopak: وَّاٰخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهٖۤ اَزْوَاجٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waakharu min shaklihi azwajun
verses.saheeh: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
verses.khattab: and other torments of the same sort
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and other (ākhar may be plural or singular) kinds [of torment] resembling it, in other words, like the boiling water and pus mentioned, in pairs, of all sorts, in other words, their chastisement will consist of various kinds.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur isi qisam ki dusri talkhiyon ka

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا فَوۡجٞ مُّقۡتَحِمٞ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡ ۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۚ لَا مَرْحَبًۢـا بِهِمْ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا النَّارِ
verses.transliteration: hatha fawjun muqtahimun ma'akum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari
verses.saheeh: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
verses.khattab: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it will be said to them as they enter the Fire with their followers: ‘This is a horde about to plunge, to enter, with you, into the Fire violently — at which point those who used to be followed say: no welcome [is there] for them [here]!, in other words, [they will find] no comfort for them [here]. They will indeed roast in the Fire’.
verses.romanUrdu: (woh jahannum ki taraf apne pairawon ko aatey dekh kar aapas mein kahenge) “Yeh ek lashkar tumhare paas ghusa chala aa raha hai, koi khushamadeed (welcome) inke liye nahin hai, yeh aag mein jhulasne waley hain”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡ ۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا بَلْ اَنْتُمْ ۗ لَا مَرْحَبًۢـا بِكُمْ ۗ اَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوْهُ لَنَا ۚ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
verses.transliteration: qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu
verses.saheeh: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
verses.khattab: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They, the followers, say, ‘Nay, but for you [there is] no welcome! You prepared this, that is, disbelief, for us. So what an evil abode!’, for us and for you, is the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh unko jawab denge “ nahin balke tum hi jhulse ja rahe ho, koi khair maqdam tumhare liye nahin. Tumhi to yeh anjaam hamare aagey laye ho. Kaisi buri hai yeh jaaye qaraar”

verses.uthmani: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابٗا ضِعۡفٗا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
verses.indopak: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى النَّارِ
verses.transliteration: qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu 'athaban di'fan fee alnnari
verses.saheeh: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
verses.khattab: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They, also, say, ‘Our Lord, whoever prepared this for us, give him double his chastisement, that is, [give him in addition] the like of his chastisement, for his disbelief, in the Fire!’
verses.romanUrdu: Phir woh kahenge “Aey hamare Rubb, jisne humein is anjaam ko pahunchane ka bandobast kiya usko dozakh ka dohra azaab de”

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰى رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَـعُدُّهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَشْرَارِ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna na'udduhum mina alashrari
verses.saheeh: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
verses.khattab: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they, the disbelievers of Mecca, say, while they are in the Fire: ‘What is the matter with us that we do not see [here] men whom we used to count, in the world, among the wicked?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh aapas mein kahenge “kya baat hai, hum un logon ko kahin nahin dekhte jinehin hum duniya mein bura samajte thay

verses.uthmani: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
verses.indopak: اَ تَّخَذْنٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا اَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْاَبْصَارُ
verses.transliteration: attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat 'anhumu alabsaru
verses.saheeh: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
verses.khattab: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did we treat them mockingly? (read sukhriyyan, or sikhriyyan), did we use to deride them in [the life of] the world (the [final] yā’ [in sikhriyyā] is attributive). In other words, are they missing? Or have [our] eyes missed them [here]?’, so that we have not caught sight of them. Such [men] were the poor among the Muslims, like ‘Ammār [b. Yāsir], Bilāl [al-Habashī], Suhayb [al-Rūmī] and Salmān [al-Fārisī].
verses.romanUrdu: Hunme yunhi unka mazaaq bana liya tha, ya woh kahin nazaron se ojhal hain?”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقّٞ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقّ ٌ تَخَاصُمُ اَهْلِ النَّارِ
verses.transliteration: inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari
verses.saheeh: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
verses.khattab: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly that is true: such [a scene] will necessarily take place, which is, the wrangling of the inhabitants of the Fire — as shown above.
verses.romanUrdu: Beshak yeh baat sacchi hai, ehle dozakh mein yahi kuch jhagde honay waley hain

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٞ ۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا۠ مُنْذِرٌ ۖ وَّمَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
verses.transliteration: qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa allahu alwahidu alqahharu
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say, O Muhammad (s), to the disbelievers of Mecca: ‘I am only a warner, to threaten [disbelievers] with [punishment in] the Fire. And there is no god except God, the One, the All-Compelling, of [all] His creatures;
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi) insey kaho, “ main to bas khabardar kardene wala hoon. Koi haqeeqi mabood nahin magar Allah, jo yakta hai, sab par gaalib

verses.uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
verses.indopak: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفَّارُ
verses.transliteration: rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma al'azeezu alghaffaru
verses.saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
verses.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, Whose way [always] prevails, the [ever] Forgiving’, of His friends.
verses.romanUrdu: Aasmaano aur zameen ka maalik aur un saari cheezon ka maalik jo inke darmiyan hain, zabardast aur darguzar karne wala”

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
verses.indopak: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيْمٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qul huwa nabaon 'atheemun
verses.saheeh: Say, "It is great news
verses.khattab: Say, “This ˹Quran˺ is momentous news
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say, to them: ‘It is a tremendous tiding
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho “ yeh ek badi khabar hai

verses.uthmani: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
verses.indopak: اَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: antum 'anhu mu'ridoona
verses.saheeh: From which you turn away.
verses.khattab: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿from which you are turning away, namely, the Qur'an, of which I have informed you and in which I have brought you what can only be known by revelation, and that is God’s saying:
verses.romanUrdu: Jisko sunkar tum mooh pherte ho”

verses.uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
verses.indopak: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِۢالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰۤى اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ma kana liya min 'ilmin bialmalai ala'la ith yakhtasimoona
verses.saheeh: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
verses.khattab: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I had no knowledge of the High Council, that is to say, [of] the angels, when they disputed, in the matter of Adam, when God, exalted be He, said [to them]: ‘I am appointing on earth a vicegerent’, to the end [of the verse, Q. 2:30].
verses.romanUrdu: (Insey kaho) “Mujhey us waqt ki koi khabar na thi jab mala-e-aala (high council) mein jhagda ho raha tha

verses.uthmani: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
verses.indopak: اِنْ يُّوْحٰۤى اِلَىَّ اِلَّاۤ اَنَّمَاۤ اَنَا۠ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
verses.transliteration: in yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
verses.khattab: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿All that is revealed to me is that I am just a plain warner’, one whose warning is clear.
verses.romanUrdu: Mujhko to wahee (revelation/inspiration) ke zariye se yeh baatein sirf isliye batayi jaati hain ke main khula khula khabardar karne wala hoon”

verses.uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ
verses.indopak: اِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىْ خَالِـقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ طِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin
verses.saheeh: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
verses.khattab: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Mention, when your Lord said to the angels, ‘Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay, and this was Adam.
verses.romanUrdu: Jab tere Rubb ne farishton se kaha “main mitti se ek bashar banane wala hoon

verses.uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهٗ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِىْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqa'oo lahu sajideena
verses.saheeh: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.khattab: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So when I have proportioned him, completed him, and breathed in him, [when I have] caused to flow [therein], My spirit, so that he becomes a living [being] — the addition of ‘the spirit’ to Adam is an honour for him; the ‘spirit’ is a subtle body that gives life to a human being by permeating him — then fall down in prostration before him!’ — a prostration of salutation [that is actually] a bow.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jab main usey puri tarah bana doon aur usmein apni rooh phoonk doon to tum uske aagey sajde mein gir jao”

verses.uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
verses.indopak: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajma'oona
verses.saheeh: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
verses.khattab: So the angels prostrated all together—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together (there are two emphases here [kulluhum and ajma‘ūn]);
verses.romanUrdu: Is hukum ke mutaabiq farishtey sab ke sab sajde mein gir gaye

verses.uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّاۤ اِبْلِيْسَ ۗ اِسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena
verses.saheeh: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
verses.khattab: but not Iblîs, who acted arrogantly, becoming unfaithful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except Iblīs, the father of the jinn, who was among the [audience of] angels; he was disdainful and he was one of the disbelievers, according to God’s knowledge, exalted be He.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar Iblis ne apni badayi ka ghamand kiya aur woh kaafiron mein se ho gaya

verses.uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّ ۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ يٰۤـاِبْلِيْسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۗ اَسْتَكْبَرْتَ اَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala ya ibleesu ma mana'aka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina al'aleena
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
verses.khattab: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘O Iblīs! What prevents you from prostrating before that which I have created with My own hands?, in other words, whose creation I [Myself] have undertaken. This [in itself] is an honour for Adam, as God has [Himself] undertaken the [unmediated] creation of all creatures. Are you being arrogant, now, in refraining from prostrating (an interrogative meant as a rebuke); or are you of the exalted?’, of the proud, and have therefore disdained to prostrate yourself, because you are one of them?
verses.romanUrdu: Rubb ne farmaya “Aey Iblis, tujhey kya cheez usko sajda karne se maanay hui jisey maine apne dono haathon se banaya hai? Tu bada ban raha hai ya tu hai hi kuch unchey darje ki hastiyon mein se?”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارٖ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينٖ
verses.indopak: قَالَ اَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۗ خَلَقْتَنِىْ مِنْ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ طِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin
verses.saheeh: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
verses.khattab: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘I am better than him. You created me from fire and You created him from clay’.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne jawab diya “main ussey behtar hoon , aapne mujhko aag se paida kiya hai aur isko mitti se”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيْمٌ ۖ
verses.transliteration: qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.khattab: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Then begone hence, that is, from Paradise — or, it is said, [begone] from the heavens — for you are indeed accursed, outcast.
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “ accha to yahan se nikal ja , tu mardood hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.indopak: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىْۤ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ
verses.transliteration: wainna 'alayka la'natee ila yawmi alddeeni
verses.saheeh: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.khattab: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed My curse shall be on you until the Day of Judgement’, [the Day] of Requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tere upar yaum ul jaza tak meri laanat hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِىْۤ اِلٰى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yub'athoona
verses.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.khattab: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘My Lord, then reprieve me until the day when they, mankind, will be raised’.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh bola “ aey mere Rubb , yeh baat hai to phir mujhey us waqt tak ke liye mohlat dey dey jab yeh log dobara uthaye jayenge”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.khattab: Allah said, “You will be delayed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Then you will indeed be among the reprieved
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya, “accha tujhey us roz tak ki mohlat hai

verses.uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
verses.indopak: اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ
verses.transliteration: ila yawmi alwaqti alma'loomi
verses.saheeh: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.khattab: until the appointed Day.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿until the day of the known time’, the time of the First Blast.
verses.romanUrdu: Jiska waqt mujhey maloom hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: qala fabi'izzatika laoghwiyannahum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
verses.khattab: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘Now, by Your might, I shall surely pervert them all,
verses.romanUrdu: Usne kaha “ teri izzat ki kasam, main in sab logon ko behka kar rahunga

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: illa 'ibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
verses.saheeh: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.khattab: except Your chosen servants among them.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except those servants of Yours among them who will be saved’, namely, the believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Bajuz tere un bandon ke jinhein tu nay khaalis karliya hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.indopak: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ ۖ وَالْحَقَّ اَ قُوْلُ ۚ
verses.transliteration: qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu
verses.saheeh: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
verses.khattab: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, ‘So the truth is — and the truth I [always] speak (read both [words] in the accusative [fa’l-haqqa wa’l-haqqa]; or with the first in the nominative and the second in the accusative because of the verb [aqūlu, ‘I speak’] that follows. As for reading the first one in the accusative, this would be on account of the mentioned verb [qāla, ‘he said’]; but it is also said to be on account of its being a verbal noun, the sense being uhiqqu l-haqqa, ‘I establish the truth’; or [it is in the accusative by implication] if the particle for the oath [fa] is removed. It [the first haqq] could also be in the nominative because of its being the subject of a missing predicate, as in fa’l-haqqu minnī, ‘truth [comes] from Me’. It is also said that [the sentence means] fa’l-haqqu qasamī, ‘the truth is [this] oath from Me’, the response to which is the following [la-amla’anna …]) —
verses.romanUrdu: Farmaya “to haqq yeh hai, aur main haqq hi kaha karta hoon

verses.uthmani: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
verses.khattab: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿I shall assuredly fill Hell with you, by way of [filling it with] your progeny, and with whoever of them follows you, that is, of mankind, all together’.
verses.romanUrdu: Ke main jahannum ko tujhse aur un sab logon se bhar dunga jo in Insano mein se teri pairwi karenge”

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ مَاۤ اَسْـَٔــلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ وَّمَاۤ اَنَا۠ مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul ma asalukum 'alayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘I do not ask of you, in return for this, for delivering the Message [to you], any reward, any fee; nor am I an impostor, so as to make up the Qur'an myself.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi) insey kehdo ke main is tableeg par tumse koi ajar nahin maangta, aur na main banawati logon mein se hoon

verses.uthmani: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: in huwa illa thikrun lil'alameena
verses.saheeh: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
verses.khattab: It is only a reminder to the whole world
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It is only, in other words, the Qur'an is only, a reminder, an admonition, for all worlds, [those of] humans, jinn and [other] rational beings, [but] excluding the angels.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh to ek naseehat hai tamam jahaan walon ke liye

verses.uthmani: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
verses.indopak: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعْدَ حِيْنِ
verses.transliteration: walata'lamunna nabaahu ba'da heenin
verses.saheeh: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
verses.khattab: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And you will assuredly come to know, O disbelievers of Mecca, its tiding, the news of its truth, in [due] time’, that is to say, on the Day of Resurrection (‘ilm, ‘knowing’, is here being used in the sense of ‘urf, ‘experience’; the prefixed lām [in la-ta‘lamunna, ‘you will assuredly know’] is for an implicit oath, in other words [what is meant is] wa’Llāhi [la-ta‘lamunna, ‘By God you will assuredly know’]).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur thodi muddat hi guzaregi ke tumhein iska haal khud maaloom ho jayega
